text: An innovated Si₃N₄ out-diffusion barrier layer was proposed for Au/Zn/Au ohmic contacts to p-type InP. Before annealing, Si₃N₄ was deposited on Au(200Å)/Zn(700Å)/Au(200Å); it was then removed with HF, and a 2000Å pure gold layer was deposited to facilitate wire bonding. The specific contact resistance dropped to a minimum of 6×10⁻⁷ Ω·cm² at an acceptor concentration of about 3×10¹⁸ cm⁻³, and the contact became perfectly Ohmic. Additionally, the Si₃N₄ layer serves as an excellent passivation layer and antireflection coating in InP/InGaAs/InP (p-i-n) photodiodes.
